newsitem.title: GERMANY: KSB expects narrower losses in full-year 1996.
newsitem.headline: KSB expects narrower losses in full-year 1996.

text.p: German pump manufacturer KSB AG said on Friday that it expects an improvement in full-year results in 1996, but that it would still report an overall loss for the year.
Losses would be narrower than in the previous year because of concentration on a restructuring plan for the parent group, but KSB still forecast double-digit growth for the year.
In the first nine months of the year, KSB reported a pre-tax loss of 9.4 million marks, up from 44.8 million marks in the same period last year.
